explanation.en: `WebApplication.CreateBuilder` plus `app.MapGet`/`app.MapPost` with lambda handlers is the ASP.NET Core minimal API hosting model in C#; the `(string name) => $"..."` lambda binds the `{name}` route value.
`builder.Services.AddScoped`/`AddSingleton`/`AddTransient<TService, TImpl>()` registers services with ASP.NET Core's built-in dependency injection container in C#, one lifetime per call.

A constructor-injected `ILogger<InvoiceService>` with a structured `LogInformation("... {InvoiceId}", id)` template is .NET Core's Microsoft.Extensions.Logging in C#; the `=>` expression-bodied constructor is C#-only.
`app.Use(async (ctx, next) => { ... await next(ctx); })` is inline ASP.NET Core middleware in C#: code before `next` runs on the way in, code after it on the way out.
`builder.Services.Configure<SmtpOptions>(builder.Configuration.GetSection("Smtp"))` plus an injected `IOptions<SmtpOptions>` read through `.Value` is the .NET Core options pattern in C#.

`Configuration.GetSection(...).Get<T>()`, `GetValue<int>("Upload:MaxMegabytes", 10)` with the colon section path, and `GetConnectionString` bind appsettings.json values in .NET Core configuration, written in C#.
A `DbContext` subclass exposing `DbSet<Product>` and overriding `OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder)` with the fluent `HasIndex(...).IsUnique()` API is Entity Framework Core in C#.

Subclassing `BackgroundService` and overriding `ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)` is how .NET Core writes a long-running hosted service (IHostedService) in C#; `PeriodicTimer.WaitForNextTickAsync` paces the loop.

A lambda with an explicit `Results<Ok<Todo>, NotFound>` return type built from `TypedResults.Ok`/`TypedResults.NotFound`, next to `Results.NoContent()`, is ASP.NET Core minimal API typed results in C#.
An `[ApiController]` class deriving from `ControllerBase` whose action returns `Task<ActionResult<OrderDto>>` via `CreatedAtAction(nameof(Create), ...)` is an ASP.NET Core Web API controller in C#.

`builder.Services.AddHttpClient("github", ...)` registers a named client and `IHttpClientFactory.CreateClient("github")` hands out pooled `HttpClient` instances: the .NET Core HTTP client factory, in C#.

`AddAuthentication().AddJwtBearer()`, the `app.UseAuthentication()`/`app.UseAuthorization()` middleware pair and `.RequireAuthorization()` on an endpoint are ASP.NET Core authentication and authorization in C#.

`Host.CreateApplicationBuilder(args)` is the .NET Core Generic Host for console and worker apps in C#; `AddHostedService<T>()` and `using IHost host = ...` then `await host.RunAsync()` start it without a web server.

`.AddEndpointFilter(async (ctx, next) => ...)` with `ctx.GetArgument<Product>(0)` is an ASP.NET Core minimal API endpoint filter in C#: it can short-circuit with `Results.BadRequest` or call `next(ctx)`.

`builder.Services.AddRateLimiter` with `AddFixedWindowLimiter("per-minute", ...)`, `app.UseRateLimiter()` and `.RequireRateLimiting(...)` is ASP.NET Core's built-in rate limiting middleware (.NET 7+) in C#.
